title: Sync to live holds a table the sync kept whole, and a record a push created then deleted on live leaves the copy
steps: Run the push flow case where the live table gains a column and the customer retitles an article.
Run the push flow case where Tracy creates an article, pushes it, and the customer deletes it on live.
expect: sync/kept.json holds the kept table and both articles in it are changed-on-both conflicts; nothing is written to them; the customer title stays on live.
After the push the copy row has the live created/modified; the next sync deletes it from the copy with nothing kept.

tests: a table Sync from live kept whole holds the push through sync/kept.json
an article a push created and the customer then deleted on the live site goes from the copy too
